postTitle: Fee Optimization: The Silent Drag on Your Returns
topic: A yearly fee of €1 on every €100 invested can take about a quarter of a 40 year pot

assumptions.notes: €10,000 start, €500 a month, 40 years, 7% nominal before fees, compounded monthly (blog model, corrected Oct 2026). Final pots: 0.05% fee €1,454,027; 0.5% €1,275,505; 1% €1,105,320; 1.5% €960,317. 1% vs 0.05%: €348,707 less, 24.0%. 1.5% vs 0.05%: €493,709, 34.0%. Before tax; returns not guaranteed.

caption.instagram:
A yearly fee of €1 on every €100 invested. What could it take over 40 years? About a quarter of the final amount, in this example.

The numbers behind the lines: €10,000 to start, €500 a month for 40 years, 7% a year before fees. At a 1% yearly fee the total reaches about €1.11M. At 0.05% it reaches about €1.45M. That is about €349,000, or 24%, less.
